ownership_comparison.bound: At most an existing bounded batch plus the next complete file. One valid file may exceed the batch budget. This bound does not include disc-reader transient copies, retained executable, native staging/active data, GPU resources or deferred garbage collection.
ownership_comparison.timing_scope: One descriptive run per variant on a shared host with instrumentation and uncontrolled driver/cache state. Not foreground timing or mobile performance admission. Wasm reservation is linear memory capacity, not live allocation or whole-process memory.
ownership_comparison.final_code_match: The final DiscAssetSession and transfer owner bytes exactly match the measured candidate. Adapter streaming behavior is unchanged; a later receiver-independent readScope compatibility repair is covered by the final focused suite and committed package route.
